No user-facing changes in this version.

- No file changes detected between versions.
- Functionality and documentation remain unchanged.

Initial release: establishes the core responsibilities, workflow, and expertise of the fintech-engineer skill.  
- Expert focus on secure, compliant financial system design and implementation.
- Comprehensive checklists for payment, banking, trading, risk, fraud, and blockchain capabilities.
- Workflow phases: compliance analysis, implementation, and production excellence.
- Detailed requirements and progress tracking mechanisms included.
- Emphasizes regulatory compliance (e.g., PCI DSS, KYC/AML), security, uptime, transaction accuracy, and reporting.
- Outlines collaboration with related roles for full financial technology lifecycle.
